aigrettes: She was formal in manner, and made calls in rustling, steel-grey brocades and a tall bonnet with bristling aigrettes.
aiguilles: Mont Blanc, the supreme and magnificent Mont Blanc, raised itself from the surrounding aiguilles, and its tremendous dôme overlooked the valley.
